purpose: Machine-readable asset inventory the Asset Scout (agents/11-asset-scout.md) iterates to source marketplace/free assets. Structure is consumed by runner.py --scout; per-asset content is derived from the richer human doc vault/00-core/asset-inventory.md (edit that, then regenerate this).

global_constraints.perspective: 2.5D side-scroller (Metroid Dread style). Assets are viewed in profile on the X/Z plane at ~900 units camera distance. Side-view silhouette legibility is the single most important selection criterion.
global_constraints.art_direction: Space fantasy. Clean hard-surface armor with fabric accents (hoods/capes); mystic technology rendered as geometry and light, not unshaped particle soup. Faction-coded color language; readable silhouettes over mesh detail.
global_constraints.ip_safety: Destiny-adjacent tone but 100% legally clean. No recognizable names, logos, or 1:1 designs from existing IP. Subtle homage is fine; direct copies are rejected.
global_constraints.license: Must permit non-commercial course use. Prefer licenses that also allow later commercial (Steam) release (CC0, CC-BY, Fab Standard License, Unreal Engine Sponsored Content; SIL Open Font License for fonts).

technical_standards.characters_bosses: <= 50k tris, game-ready rig, PBR maps (Albedo, Normal, Roughness/Metallic)
technical_standards.humanoid_rig: UE5 skeleton (Manny/Quinn) compatible or Mixamo auto-riggable
technical_standards.audio: royalty-free, WAV (44.1kHz, 16-24 bit) or OGG, clean seamless loops

source_legend.marketplace: The Asset Scout searches and shortlists candidates. The whole project is marketplace/free art only — no commissioned artist, no original 3D art.

phase_legend.R3: 4-10 Aug: PEAK demand (enemies, weapons, environment kit, combat VFX, props).
phase_legend.R4: 11-17 Aug: main boss, knights, boss arena, boss VFX.

assets.name: Hunter (agile class)
assets.description: Lean, high-mobility silhouette. Optional tattered hood/cloak and sleek sci-fi light armor. Reads instantly as 'the fast, agile gunslinger' from the side.
search_keywords: space fantasy rogue character game ready
assets.technical_specs: <= 50k tris. Rigged humanoid, UE5-skeleton compatible or Mixamo-riggable. PBR 2K/4K. Sockets: weapon_r (hand cannon), grapple_socket (wrist/waist tether).
assets.acceptance: Crisp side-readable silhouette distinct from Titan; clean A/T-pose; functional cloth physics on cape/hood if present.
assets.ip_safety: Silhouette evokes a hooded space gunslinger; must not copy any specific character design from Destiny or Star Wars.

assets.name: Titan (heavyweight class)
assets.description: Bulky, heavy hard-surface powered armor, broad shoulders, grounded stance. Silhouette reads as 'the tank' in profile — wide, heavy, industrial.
search_keywords: bulky powered armor character game ready
assets.technical_specs: <= 50k tris. Rigged humanoid, UE5-skeleton or Mixamo-riggable. PBR. Sockets: weapon_r (auto rifle), shield_attach (left forearm energy shield).
assets.acceptance: Strong mass contrast vs Hunter; wide footprint; tested with charge-bash animations.
assets.ip_safety: Standard heavy powered-armor archetype; keep plate shapes distinct.

assets.name: Hand Cannon (Hunter primary)
assets.description: Semi-automatic sci-fi heavy revolver-pistol. Hard-surface, chunky, high-precision feel. Reads from the side as a single crisp silhouette in the Hunter's hand.
assets.technical_specs: <= 8k tris. Separate mesh with grip pivot. Socket: MuzzleFlashSocket. PBR 2K.
assets.acceptance: Side-readable profile at ~900u camera distance; detached mesh.
assets.ip_safety: Avoid replicating iconic named weapons (e.g. Fatebringer, Thorn).

assets.name: Auto Rifle (Titan primary)
assets.description: Automatic sustained-fire sci-fi rifle. Heavier and longer than the hand cannon; suppression weapon. Hard-surface, industrial.
assets.technical_specs: <= 10k tris. Separate mesh. Sockets: MuzzleFlashSocket, EjectSocket. PBR.
assets.acceptance: Reads cleanly in Titan's two-handed grip.

assets.name: Grapple Chain Knife (Hunter traversal)
assets.description: A throwing knife tethered by a chain or energy cord, used as a grappling traversal tool that anchors to ceiling/wall points.
assets.technical_specs: Blade mesh (<= 3k tris) + tileable/stretchable chain segment or cable for a UE5 cable component.
assets.acceptance: Detachable blade mesh to project the anchor point visually.

assets.name: Crawler (melee swarm)
assets.description: Small, fast pursuer that follows floors, walls, and ceilings. Insectoid or skittering-robotic. Low HP swarm unit providing room friction.
assets.technical_specs: Rigged for fast locomotion. <= 15k tris. Anims: Idle, Run, Attack, Death.
assets.acceptance: Fluid run animation; aligns easily to sloped geometry.

assets.name: Ledge Gunner (elevated shooter)
assets.description: Stationary or platform-bound ranged shooter fixed to ledges and alcoves. Fires line-of-sight energy projectiles at intervals. Turret-like or gunner silhouette.
assets.technical_specs: <= 15k tris. Articulated mesh with aim/fire animation and MuzzleSocket.
assets.acceptance: Clear telegraph wind-up animation; distinct muzzle point in 2.5D profile.

assets.name: Shieldbearer (chokepoint wall)
assets.description: Heavy humanoid carrying a full-height frontal energy/physical shield plus a knockback melee. A moving wall the player solves by going over (Hunter) or through (Titan).
assets.technical_specs: Heavy humanoid rig + separate shield mesh (<= 20k tris total) to support energy VFX attachment.
assets.acceptance: Wide frontal silhouette dominated by the shield; shield can fully obscure the body in side view.

assets.name: Walking Bomb (proximity explosion)
assets.description: Slow, volatile ground unit that rushes when the player is near and detonates on contact or death. Needs an unstable/overcharged emissive state.
assets.technical_specs: <= 15k tris. Simple rig + exposed emissive material parameter for the flashing telegraph.
assets.acceptance: Adjustable emissive pulse via material parameters.

assets.name: Blink Tank (teleport heavy)
assets.description: High-HP heavy that takes initial damage then teleports behind the player to strike. Slow, imposing bruiser silhouette.
assets.technical_specs: <= 25k tris. Bruiser rig + heavy melee swing and vanish/reappear animations.
assets.acceptance: Melee strike animation with clear visual weight.

assets.name: La Costurera (main boss — witch)
assets.description: Alien witch fighting at range with energy volleys and beams while guiding the revive weave of her knights. Elegant/svelte duelist with a glaive and thread motif. Tall, imposing caster silhouette.
assets.technical_specs: <= 60k tris. Full rig with flowing robes/fabric. PBR with intense emissive maps. Sockets: cast origin, weave_hand_l, weave_hand_r.
assets.acceptance: Majestically menacing silhouette; casting, channel, and floating locomotion animations.
assets.ip_safety: Inspired by space-witch archetypes (e.g. a Hive-Wizard silhouette) but an original ceremonial design — not dirty/organic.

assets.name: Revived Knights (boss vanguard)
assets.description: Two monumental humanoid knights in ancient sci-fi armor with greatswords, providing melee pressure. When downed they enter a petrified state while La Costurera's threads re-stitch them.
assets.technical_specs: <= 40k tris. Single optimized rig reusable at two scale factors. Melee sweep, downed, revive-idle animations.
assets.acceptance: Single mesh scalable to 2 sizes; heavy combat stance; compatible with revive-weave VFX.

assets.name: Architect Ruins Modular Kit
assets.description: Ancient, colossal, decaying structures of stone and dark metal alloys built by a long-gone civilization (the Architects). Corridors, walls, floors, ceilings, ledges, pillars, arches tiling cleanly on a 2.5D plane. ~30-50 pieces.
assets.technical_specs: UE5 Nanite geometry. Grid snapping on X/Z (100u/400u increments). Shared PBR materials / trim sheets for low draw calls.
assets.acceptance: Zero visible seams when snapped on the side plane; cohesive cosmic-ruin art style. The single largest, most schedule-critical purchase.

assets.name: Boss Chamber / Arena
assets.description: Large ceremonial/ritual chamber for the La Costurera fight. Open floor space for knight melee and witch repositioning; dramatic, ancient, sealed feeling.
assets.technical_specs: Nanite geometry. Matches env-modular-kit. At least 3000 units horizontal floor space.
assets.acceptance: Unobstructed profile camera view; clear room bounds.

assets.name: Grapple Anchor Point
assets.description: Ceiling/wall target device that glows steadily, signalling to the Hunter 'grapple here'.
assets.technical_specs: <= 3k tris. High-contrast emissive material.
assets.acceptance: Small, high-contrast, side-readable.

assets.name: Destructible Wall (Titan bash)
assets.description: Cracked, reinforced ruin wall that Titan breaks with Charge Bash. Needs an intact state and a fractured/debris state.
assets.technical_specs: <= 8k tris. Chaos Physics ready in UE5.
assets.acceptance: Reads clearly as 'breakable' vs a normal wall; matches env kit.

assets.name: Keycard Door + Pickup
assets.description: Sliding sci-fi door with an access terminal, plus a floating holographic keycard pickup prop.
assets.technical_specs: Door mesh with open/close animation or slide bones. Pickup with spin movement.
assets.acceptance: Door open/close is Blueprint-drivable; keycard is a small, readable pickup.

assets.name: Boss Door
assets.description: Large, imposing sealed door preceding the boss chamber. Ceremonial, ancient, clearly a point of no return.
assets.technical_specs: Large-scale mesh with an opening animation sequence.
assets.acceptance: Matches env kit; open sequence Blueprint-drivable.

assets.name: Beacon (checkpoint / respawn anchor)
assets.description: Architect shrine/pillar device that emits warm, safe light. Fully restores health and anchors the respawn point.
assets.technical_specs: <= 10k tris. Emissive material with an idle pulse and an activation burst state.
assets.acceptance: Emissive, side-readable; distinct enough that the player learns to read it as 'safe'.

assets.name: Lore Props (murals, terminals, fragments)
assets.description: Carved stone murals, sci-fi data terminals with screens, and small collectible data-fragment nodes. Text content is generated by the Lore Scribe agent; these are the physical carriers.
assets.technical_specs: <= 5k tris each. Emissive terminal screens.
assets.acceptance: Readable in profile; terminal supports an emissive screen; mural is a wall decal or shallow relief.

assets.name: The Weave / Luminous Threads
assets.description: Signature energy effect: luminous threads and geometric light ribbons (NOT unshaped smoke). Anchor of the whole VFX identity.
assets.technical_specs: Niagara particle system. Exposed color parameters.
assets.acceptance: Reads as threads/light, not smoke; recolorable; readable at side-scroller distance.

assets.name: Knight Revive Weave
assets.description: Thread effect that visibly re-stitches a downed knight's body over 8-12 seconds, serving as the fight's timer telegraph.
assets.technical_specs: Progress parameter (0.0 -> 1.0) driven via Blueprint; attaches to the knight mesh; derived from vfx-weave.
assets.acceptance: Time-parameterized; clearly telegraphs progress.

assets.name: Combat VFX Set
assets.description: Muzzle flashes, energy projectile traces, impact hits for the hand cannon/auto rifle, and the Walking Bomb explosion.
assets.technical_specs: Niagara systems optimized for low latency. Recolorable.
assets.acceptance: Readable at side-scroller distance; recolorable to the faction palette.

assets.name: Ability & Traversal VFX
assets.description: Grapple chain trail, Titan charge-bash impact, Hunter dodge i-frame flash, energy shield (Titan + Shieldbearer), and ground pulse.
assets.technical_specs: Attachable to sockets and character materials. Recolorable per faction.
assets.acceptance: Distinct silhouettes so the verbs are legible in profile.

assets.name: Blink / Teleport VFX
assets.description: Short phase-shift flash for the Blink Tank and La Costurera teleportation.
assets.technical_specs: Niagara; short, punchy, recolorable.
assets.acceptance: Reads as a fast phase-shift matching the weave/light identity.

assets.name: Boss Attack VFX
assets.description: Predictive energy volley patterns, floor danger telegraphs, and area-denial energy beams.
assets.technical_specs: Niagara; clear wind-up telegraph; recolorable.
assets.acceptance: Side-readable danger zones; telegraphed a beat ahead.

assets.name: Checkpoint Activation VFX
assets.description: Idle warm glow and an activation energy burst for the Beacon device.
assets.technical_specs: Loopable idle + one-shot activation.
assets.acceptance: Warm, safe glow contrasting the cold ruins.

assets.name: Soundtrack (exploration, combat, boss)
assets.description: Melancholic, vast sci-fi ambient bed for exploration; a tension percussive layer for combat; an epic orchestral/synth boss theme for La Costurera.
search_keywords: epic boss battle theme royalty free
assets.technical_specs: Royalty-free commercial license. WAV 24-bit / 44.1kHz. Seamless loop points; stems preferred.
assets.acceptance: Loopable; lonely, vast, reverent tone.

assets.name: Combat & Weapon SFX
assets.description: Crisp heavy hand cannon shots, auto rifle bursts, impacts, shield hits, explosions, and enemy hurt/death sounds. ~20-40 files.
assets.technical_specs: Royalty-free WAV; multiple variations per event to avoid repetition.
assets.acceptance: Punchy, energy-tech tone.

assets.name: Locomotion & Ability SFX
assets.description: Stone/metal footsteps, double-jump whooshes, grapple chain whir, charge-bash impact, and dodge swishes. ~15-30 files.
assets.technical_specs: Royalty-free; light and heavy variants (Hunter vs Titan).
assets.acceptance: Class-distinct where possible.

assets.name: UI, Boss & Ambience SFX
assets.description: Clean UI clicks, checkpoint activation stingers, boss vocal cues, and ambient room hums. ~15-25 files.
assets.technical_specs: Royalty-free; ambience loops seamlessly.
assets.acceptance: UI is crisp; ambience is unobtrusive.

assets.name: HUD Art Kit
assets.description: Minimalist Dread-style HUD glyphs: health pips, Titan shield-meter frame, interact glyphs, keycard icon. Layout/UMG is produced by the UI Designer agent; this supplies the visual atoms.
assets.technical_specs: PNG vector art / 4K textures with transparency.
assets.acceptance: Restrained, high-contrast; matches the faction color language.

assets.name: Technical UI Font (Latin Extended / ES support)
assets.description: Legible futuristic sci-fi typeface. MANDATORY full support for Spanish diacritics (a, e, i, o, u with accents, n-tilde, inverted ? and !), because both EN and ES ship.
assets.technical_specs: TTF/OTF with an open license permitting game embedding (SIL Open Font License / Google Fonts).
assets.acceptance: License allows game embedding; includes Spanish diacritics.

assets.name: Hard-Surface Master Material & Trim Sheets
assets.description: Master material and trim-sheet set to unify marketplace assets from different creators under the project's faction color language. Cohesion glue for mixed-source assets.
assets.technical_specs: Parameterized master material (tint, roughness offset, metallic multiplier, normal intensity, Nanite support).
assets.acceptance: Recolorable; Nanite/PBR compatible.
